independence.polynomialIdentityChecker: math-anchor-stdlib-polynomial-checker recomputes coefficients without importing the SymPy producer
independence.otherKinds: expression_equivalence and dimension_consistency reuse the same registered providers as the MCP catalog; they are not a second checker stack

arms.description: Model-only (no mathematical provider). Interface and recorded protocol for a later live run. Not executed in this smoke.

Model plus current MCP compatibility surface (math.search / math.describe / math.run / math.batch), voluntary tool use. No fifth MCP tool. Interface and recorded protocol for a later live run. Not executed in this smoke.
Explicit structured claims submitted as math-anchor.obligation-set.v0.1. Full feedback. Reuses the existing obligation runtime; not a second stack.

Host/harness shadow checkpoint: full receipt stored outside the model context; library quiet success zeros modelContextBytes by wrapper projection when checked (product evidence is CLI --quiet-success empty stdout); failures_only feedback only when action is required; seeded same-claim repair-loop hook (pre-authored correction, not a live model repair; unrelated valid resubmits are not repair probes).

corruptionKinds.none: Valid control claim; used to measure false reject (G3), not detection (G1).
corruptionKinds.sign_flip: Polynomial identity with a flipped bilinear sign. Supported seeded error; provider should falsify.
corruptionKinds.stale_swapped_result: A valid certificate for a different identity is bound to this claim. Independent checker must reject (unknown / certificate_rejected), not check.
corruptionKinds.wrong_witness: Producer witness for x = x bound to (x+y)^2 identity. Same binding path as stale_swapped_result; claim-binding, not a second stack.
corruptionKinds.wrong_claim_binding: Certificate statement fields do not match the caller's normalized left/right/variables.
corruptionKinds.domain_overshoot: Removable discontinuity treated as an identity under strict definedness. Looks equivalent; provider should falsify.
corruptionKinds.dimension_mismatch: Dimensionally inconsistent formula. Supported seeded error; provider should falsify.
corruptionKinds.unsupported_kind: Unregistered obligation kind. Completeness case (explicit unsupported), not a G1 supported seeded error.
corruptionKinds.dependency_blocked: Downstream obligation gated on an unchecked dependency. Completeness case, not a G1 supported seeded error.
corruptionKinds.rounding_sneak: Exact rational identity replaced by a rounded decimal that still looks numeric (e.g. 1/3 ≈ 0.333333). Supported seeded error; expression equivalence should falsify under exact symbolic checking.
corruptionKinds.unit_scale_mismatch: Dimension formula that still looks numeric but uses a wrong unit kind (e.g. pressure = force / area with area as meter instead of meter^2). Supported seeded error; dimension_consistency should falsify. Note: SI prefix scale alone (kilometer vs meter) is NOT caught by the current provider and is not seeded as a G1 cell.
corruptionKinds.assumption_swap: Principal-square-root identity claimed for all reals without the needed domain assumption (sqrt(x)^2 = x under strict real). Looks like a routine identity; supported seeded error; expression equivalence should falsify.
corruptionKinds.step_n_legal_wrong_value: Step-N result replaced with another legal polynomial identity that is wrong for this claim (e.g. claim (x+y)^2 expands to x^2 - y^2, which is legal for (x+y)(x-y) but not for this left-hand side). Supported seeded error; polynomial_identity should falsify.
corruptionKinds.si_prefix_scale_blind_spot: Completeness / coverage-gap case: work = force * distance with distance in kilometer while work is joule. Base dimensions match so the current provider returns checked. Not a G1 supported seeded error; documents that SI prefix scale is outside this smoke's detection claim.

G1.name: detection
G1.target: at least 80% detection of supported seeded errors
G1.thisSmokeMeasures: B2/B3 deterministic corpus (original three plus rounding / unit-kind / assumption-swap / step-N legal-wrong) plus structural binding probes
G1.note: A this-machine B2/B3 detection rate is not Epoch 2 G1. G1 needs live four-arm evidence. SI prefix scale blind-spot is completeness-only and does not count toward G1.

G2.name: accepted-error-drop
G2.target: material reduction in accepted mathematical errors against the matched no-provider (B0) condition

G3.name: false-reject
G3.target: valid control claims stay checked (low false reject)
G3.thisSmokeMeasures: B2/B3 control cells must be checked
G3.note: This-machine zero false reject on two controls is not a live-model G3 result.

G4.name: context
G4.target: main-context growth near or below 10%; successful checkpoints return zero content (quiet success)
G4.thisSmokeMeasures: B3 library quiet success zeros modelContextBytes by wrapper projection when feedback.status is checked; that is not Host I/O. Product evidence is CLI --quiet-success empty stdout. The 10% vs B0 comparison is live-only
G4.note: Silence on success is zero returned content, not proof the Agent used the receipt. B3 library 0-byte cells are the harness wrapper; CLI --quiet-success empty stdout is the product path.

G5.name: repair
G5.target: after failures_only, a repair loop can resubmit and reach checked / quiet success
G5.thisSmokeMeasures: same-claim seeded correction on sign-flip only; dimension-mismatch follow-up is an unrelated valid resubmit (force = mass * acceleration), not a repair of distance vs speed+time
G5.note: Seeded same-claim correction is a harness hook with a pre-authored correction of the original claim. Submitting a different valid claim is not a repair probe. Neither is evidence that a model repaired from feedback. G5 remains unmet.

G6.name: strong-and-weak-models
G6.target: detection / accepted-error / context gates hold for both a stronger and a weaker model under the same protocol

workload.question: Can the existing obligation runtime detect seeded mathematical corruptions (B2) and project Host shadow-checkpoint semantics (B3: quiet success, failures_only, receipt outside model context, repair hook) without a second stack, while recording B0/B1 as deferred live-model arms?
notClaimed: independent checker for every obligation kind

tasks.prompt: As polynomials in x and y over the rationals, is (x + y)^2 identical to x^2 + 2*x*y + y^2?
Is force dimensionally consistent with mass * acceleration when force is newton, mass kilogram, and acceleration meter / second^2?
As polynomials in x and y over the rationals, is (x + y)^2 identical to x^2 - 2*x*y + y^2?

repair.note: Same identity as the seeded error, with the bilinear sign restored. Pre-authored; not a live model repair.

tasks.prompt: Under a strict real definedness policy, are (x^2 - 1)/(x - 1) and x + 1 equivalent for all real x?
Is distance dimensionally consistent with speed + time when distance is meter, speed meter / second, and time second?

repair.note: This payload is the G3 control (force = mass * acceleration), not a correction of distance vs speed + time. It is not a repair probe.

tasks.prompt: Under exact real arithmetic, is 1/3 identical to the rounded decimal 0.333333?
tasks.honestyNote: G1-supported seeded error. Primary is the rounded claim; the exact 1/3+1/3+1/3=1 sibling is present to show the chain context. Adversarial framing (rounding sneaks into an otherwise exact chain) stays controller-only.

controllerOracleNote.corruptionJudgment: Adversarial: rounding sneaks into an otherwise exact chain.

tasks.prompt: Is pressure dimensionally consistent with force / area when pressure is pascal, force newton, and area meter?
tasks.honestyNote: G1-supported seeded error (wrong unit kind: area given as meter instead of meter^2). Judgment stays controller-only; agent-facing prompt must not say the unit kind is wrong. SI prefix scale alone is a separate completeness blind-spot cell, not this task.

controllerOracleNote.corruptionJudgment: Looks numeric; unit kind is wrong (area as meter, not meter^2).

tasks.prompt: Under a strict real definedness policy, is sqrt(x)^2 identical to x for all real x?
tasks.honestyNote: G1-supported seeded error (domain assumption swapped). Adversarial framing stays controller-only.

controllerOracleNote.corruptionJudgment: Adversarial: certificate/identity looks fine if the non-negative assumption is silently swapped in.

tasks.prompt: After establishing (x + y)*(x - y) = x^2 - y^2, is (x + y)^2 identical to x^2 - y^2?
tasks.honestyNote: G1-supported seeded error. Step-1 is a legal identity; step-2 reuses a legal RHS that is wrong for (x+y)^2. Judgment stays controller-only; agent-facing prompt must not say the identity is wrong for this claim.

controllerOracleNote.corruptionJudgment: Adversarial: step-N result replaced with another legal identity that is wrong for this claim.

tasks.prompt: Check the unregistered obligation that H^1(X, O_X) = 0 as sheaf cohomology vanishing.
After an unregistered sheaf-cohomology step, check the polynomial identity x = x that depends on it.
Is work dimensionally consistent with force * distance when work is joule, force newton, and distance kilometer?
tasks.honestyNote: Completeness-only / coverage gap. Expected checked because dimension.check ignores SI prefixes. Not a G1 seeded error and not a G3 control. Completeness framing stays controller-only.

controllerOracleNote.corruptionJudgment: Completeness: current provider checks base dimensions only; SI prefix scale is a known blind spot, not a G1 detection claim.

structuralProbes.notes: Binding probes reuse math_anchor.obligations claim-binding (valid certificate for a different statement → unknown / certificate_rejected). Expanded adversarial probes reuse the same obligation runtime on rounding / unit-kind / assumption-swap / step-N cells. CLI probes reuse check-obligations --quiet-success. Not a parallel checker.

scoring.detection: A supported seeded error is detected when the primary obligation status is not checked and matches the pre-registered expectedPrimaryStatus. G1 supported set includes sign-flip, domain-overshoot, dimension-mismatch, rounding-in-exact-chain, unit-scale-mismatch, assumption-swapped, and step-n-legal-wrong-value. Completeness and SI prefix blind-spot cells are excluded from G1.
scoring.falseReject: A G3 control is a false reject when the primary obligation status is not checked.
scoring.quietSuccess: B3 library quiet success zeros modelContextBytes by wrapper projection when every obligation is checked. The runtime failures_only envelope is still non-empty; product evidence is CLI --quiet-success empty stdout. The full receipt remains a local artifact.
scoring.repair: B3 repair probes are same-claim seeded corrections only (sign-flip restores +2xy on the same identity). An unrelated valid resubmit (dimension-mismatch to force = mass * acceleration) is recorded but is not a repair of the original claim. Live model repair is deferred. G5 remains unmet.

decisionRule.promote: Forbidden in this smoke. Do not promote method packs. Do not start H1. Deterministic B2/B3 detection is not Epoch 2 completion.
decisionRule.targeted_fix: B2/B3 missed a pre-registered status, a control was not checked, quiet success returned model-context bytes, a binding probe checked a swapped certificate, or core.v0.1.json drifted.
decisionRule.evidence_insufficient: Default for promotion and for Epoch 2 completion. Live B0/B1/G2/G6 remain deferred.
